Pick a colour scheme

', '', '', '', '

Each control below switches this whole site between Auto, Light and Dark. They are one block wearing the Material 3 treatments and settings it offers. Try one, then scroll: the page follows immediately, and the choice is remembered.

', '', '', '', '

Filled

', '', '', '', '', '', '

Tonal, icons only

', '', '', '', '

With the labels off, each segment carries a tooltip instead. Hover one, or hold it on a touchscreen. Screen readers get the name either way.

', '', '', '', '', '', '

Outlined

', '', '', '', '', '', '

One button that cycles

', '', '', '', '

The same three schemes, advanced one press at a time. This one is a standard icon button: no container, the symbol carrying the state.

', '', '', '', '', '', '

Group on wide screens, one button on narrow

', '', '', '', '

Narrow the window past 600 pixels to watch this one compress. Only one of the two is ever in the page, so only one is ever announced.
